skill.name: qa
skill.description: Runs approved test, typecheck, and lint commands in an agent-flow worktree. It retries failures once and returns redacted, structured results without editing files.
skill.summary: Run read-only quality checks and distinguish repeatable failures from flaky results.
skill.author: drix10

security_audit.summary: All 12 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, not Ruby or shell backtick execution. The skill still intentionally executes repository checks and dependency installs, which can run repository-controlled code.

remediation.issue: Repository-defined commands and dependency installs can execute untrusted code.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit command approval, use an allowlist, disable package lifecycle scripts where possible, and run checks in a restricted sandbox.

semantic_findings.description: The skill runs orchestrator or repository-defined checks and may install dependencies. Those operations can execute repository-controlled code despite worktree mutation controls.

content.value_statement: Test failures, type errors, and lint issues can be difficult to classify consistently. This skill runs approved checks, retries failures once, and returns structured evidence.
actual_capabilities: Runs orchestrator-provided test, typecheck, and lint commands in an issue worktree.
Uses commands from AGENTS.md when the orchestrator provides none.
Retries each failing command once to identify flaky results.
Records command names, exit codes, durations, and bounded raw output.
Redacts detected credential values before returning results.
Reports whether all checks passed, passed after retry, or failed.
limitations: Requires the agent-flow orchestrator and an issue worktree.
Does not diagnose failures or recommend fixes.
Does not modify source files, snapshots, or lockfiles.
Relies on configured commands and does not create missing checks.

use_cases.title: Validate an approved change
use_cases.description: Run repository checks after review and return evidence for the final merge decision.

use_cases.title: Classify intermittent failures
use_cases.description: Retry failed checks once and identify tests that pass only on the second run.

use_cases.title: Collect structured check results
use_cases.description: Capture bounded command output, timing, and exit codes for downstream orchestration.

prompt_templates.title: Run the standard quality gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the QA gate for issue {issue_number} in {worktree_path}. Use the configured test, typecheck, and lint commands.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a standard read-only QA run.

prompt_templates.title: Run specified checks
prompt_templates.prompt: In {worktree_path}, run these approved commands: {commands}. Retry each failure once and return the required structured result.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use an explicit command list from the orchestrator.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a suspected flaky test
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the approved test command for issue {issue_number}. Retry it once after failure and list first-run tests that pass on retry.
prompt_templates.scenario: Separate flaky test behavior from repeatable failures.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a large verification suite
prompt_templates.prompt: Run all approved checks in {worktree_path}. Record durations and exit codes, redact credentials, and apply the documented output limits exactly.
prompt_templates.scenario: Process verbose checks while preserving useful evidence.

output_examples.input: Run the standard checks for issue 42.
output_examples.output: Passed: test, typecheck, and lint completed successfully on their first runs. No flaky tests were reported.

output_examples.input: Run the test command and verify any failure once.
output_examples.output: Passed with flaky results: the first test run failed, the retry passed, and the affected test name was recorded.

output_examples.input: Run the configured checks where lint fails twice.
output_examples.output: Failed: lint returned a nonzero exit code on both attempts. The bounded raw output and command durations were retained.

best_practices: Provide explicit, reviewed commands through the orchestrator.
Run the skill inside the intended restricted QA environment.
Review redacted raw output before making a merge decision.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to edit code or update snapshots.
Do not use commands copied from untrusted test output.
Do not treat a single failed run as conclusive when retry data exists.

faq.question: Does this skill fix failing tests?
faq.answer: No. It runs checks and reports results without changing the repository.

faq.question: How does it identify flaky tests?
faq.answer: It retries each failing command once and records tests that pass only during the retry.

faq.question: Which commands does it run?
faq.answer: It uses orchestrator-provided commands or configured test, typecheck, and lint commands from AGENTS.md.

faq.question: Can it install dependencies?
faq.answer: It may perform a clean lockfile-based install when dependencies are missing.

faq.question: How does it handle long output?
faq.answer: It keeps the first 150 and last 150 lines and marks the omitted section.

faq.question: How does it protect credentials?
faq.answer: It replaces detected token, key, and password values with a redaction marker.
